content.value: The temperature (in degrees Celsius) at a point $( x , y , z )$ in a metal solid is
(i) Find the rate of change of temperature with respect to distance at $( 1 , 1 , 1 )$ in the direction of the origin.
(ii) Find the direction along which the temperature drops most rapidly at the point (1,1,1).
(iii) Find the rate at which the temperature drops moving from $^ { ( 1 , 1 , 1 ) }$ in the direction obtained in (ii).

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2022
